claims.excerpt: The SOFAR Channel Carries Distant Whale Calls
claims.claim: The SOFAR channel carries whale calls over long distances.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: This naturally occurring ocean channel allows low-frequency sound to travel long distances as sound waves bend up and down. Hydrophones at the channel's axis can detect faraway sounds, including whale calls.
claims.narrative: The central idea is that this channel’s sound-carrying behavior makes faraway whale calls audible to hydrophones.
claims.explanation: The title concisely expresses the source-supported connection between the channel, long-distance sound, and whale-call detection.
claims.materiality: The title accurately states the piece’s central idea.
